subject: Error: 'dt' is not an exported object from 'namespace:nimble'

messages.subject: Error: 'dt' is not an exported object from 'namespace:nimble'

messages.author: b252c8306d50e349
messages.subject: Re: Error: 'dt' is not an exported object from 'namespace:nimble'
parts:
Hi Khaoula, 

the name of the student T distribution in NIMBLE is actually dt_nonstandard. I think you can solve it just running

curve(nimble::dt_nonstandard(x,mu=1,sigma=1e-04,df=5),from=0,to=5,n=1000)

Best, 

Sally
